sanskrit: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yanty aktubhiḥ | sūrāya viśvacakṣase ||
english: Away they go like thieves, as the stars depart through the nights, before the Sun, the all-seeing.

sanskrit: adṛśram asya ketavo vi raśmayo janām̐ anu | bhrājanto agnayo yathā ||
english: His beams, his rays, have become visible spreading among the peoples, blazing like fires.

sanskrit: taraṇir viśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛd asi sūrya | viśvam ā bhāsi rocanaḥ ||
english: Swift, visible to all, maker of light, O Sun — you illuminate all things, shining brilliantly.

sanskrit: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅ ud eṣi mānuṣīḥ | pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svar dṛśe ||
english: Facing the host of gods, facing the races of men, you rise; facing all things you rise to be seen in the sky.

sanskrit: yenā pāvaka cakṣuṣā bhuraṇyantaṃ janām̐ anu | tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||
english: With that purifying eye, O Varuṇa, you behold the bustling peoples moving about.

sanskrit: vi dyām eṣi rajas pṛthv ahar mimāno aktubhiḥ | paśyan janmāni sūrya ||
english: You traverse the broad sky and the wide atmosphere, measuring out the day with the nights, beholding all created beings, O Sun.

sanskrit: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya | śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇam ||
english: The seven tawny mares carry you on your chariot, O divine Sun — you who have flames for hair, you the far-seeing.

sanskrit: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ | tabhir yāti svayuktibhiḥ ||
english: The Sun has yoked the seven bright daughters of his chariot; by them he travels, self-harnessed.

sanskrit: abhi mā varcasā giraḥ siñcantīr ā caraṇyatha | abhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ ||
english: Sprinkling me with radiance, the hymns come toward me as you move about, as milk-cows come toward a calf.

sanskrit: tā arṣanti śubhriyaḥ pṛñcatīr varcasā priyaḥ | jātaṃ jātrīr yathā hṛdā ||
english: They flow bright, mingling their radiance with dear ones, as mothers who gave birth hold the newborn to the heart.

sanskrit: vajrāyeva sāddhiyaḥ kīrtiṃ śremāṇam ā vahān | mahyam āyur ghṛtapriyaḥ ||
english: Like a thunderbolt well aimed, O one dear to ghee, bring to me renown and industry; bring long life to me.

sanskrit: rohito divam ākramīt tapasā tapasvī | sa yonim aiti sa u jāyate punaḥ sa devānām adhipatir babhūva ||
english: Rohita, the Ruddy One, ascended heaven by his heat, himself full of heat. He goes to the womb; he is born again; he has become lord over the gods.

sanskrit: yo viśvacarṣaṇir uta viśvatomukho viśvataspāṇir utaviśvataspṛdhaḥ | saṃ bāhubhyāṃ bharati saṃ patatrair dyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ ||
english: He who encompasses all creatures, who faces all directions, whose hands stretch in all directions, who strives from all sides — with his two arms and with his wings he gathers in; he, the one god, brings forth heaven and earth.

sanskrit: ekapād dvipado bhūyo vi cakrame dvipāt tripādam abhy eti paścāt | tripād dha ṣaṭpado bhūyo vi cakrame ta ekapadas tanvāṃ sam āsate ||
english: The one-footed one strode forth further into the two-footed; from two feet he approaches the three-footed behind. The three-footed one strode forth further into the six-footed; those one-footed ones are gathered together into a body.

sanskrit: atandro yāsyan harito yad āsthā divi rūpaṃ kṛṇuṣe rocamānaḥ | ketumām̐ udyan sahamāno rajāṃsi viśvā āditya pravato vi bhāsi ||
english: Untiring as you go, when you, the Tawny One, have mounted your form in heaven shining brilliantly — rising with a banner, overpowering the realms, O Āditya, you shine brightly over all the heights.

sanskrit: baṇ mahām̐ asi sūrya baḍ āditya mahām̐ asi | mahāṃs te mahato mahimā tvam āditya mahām̐ asi ||
english: Verily great are you, O Sun; verily great are you, O Āditya. Great is your greatness from the great; you, O Āditya, are great.

sanskrit: rocase divi rocase antarikṣe pataṅga pṛthivyāṃ rocase rocase apsv antaḥ | ubhā samudrau rucyā vy āpitha devo devāsi mahiṣaḥ svarvit ||
english: You shine in heaven, you shine in the atmosphere, O Bird; you shine on earth, you shine in the waters within. Both oceans you have pervaded with your brilliance — a god among gods, you are the mighty one, the knower of the sun-world.

sanskrit: arvāk parastād viyato vyadhva āśur vipaścit patayan pataṅgaḥ | viṣṇur vicittaḥ śavasādhitiṣṭhan pra ketunā sahate viśvam ejat ||
english: Flying hither and thither through the expanded region, swift, wise, soaring — the Bird; Viṣṇu, discerning, standing firm with his power, with his banner overpowers all that stirs.

sanskrit: tigmo vibhrājan tanvaḥ śiśāno 'raṃgamāsaḥ pravato rarāṇaḥ | jyotiṣmān pakṣī mahiṣo vayodhā viśvā āsthāt pradiśaḥ kalpamānaḥ ||
english: Sharp, blazing, sharpening his body, swift-going, exulting over the heights — the luminous Bird, the great bull, sustainer of life, has taken his stand over all the quarters, arranging them.

sanskrit: citraś cikitvān mahiṣaḥ suparṇa ārocayan rodasī antarikṣam | ahorātre pari sūryaṃ vasāne prāsya viśvā tirato vīryāṇi ||
english: The brilliant, knowing bull, the beautiful-winged one, illumining the two worlds and the atmosphere — day and night clothing themselves around the Sun — his heroic powers extend beyond all.

sanskrit: citraṃ devānāṃ ketur anīkaṃ jyotiṣmān pradiśaḥ sūrya udyan | divākaro ati dyumnais tamāṃsi viśvātārīd duritāni śukraḥ ||
english: The brilliant banner of the gods, the luminous face of all the quarters, the Sun rising — the maker of day has crossed beyond all darkness with his splendors; the pure one has crossed beyond all difficulties.

sanskrit: citraṃ devānām ud agād anīkaṃ cakṣur mitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatas tasthuṣaś ca ||
english: The brilliant face of the gods has risen — the eye of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of Agni. He has filled heaven and earth and the atmosphere; the Sun is the soul of all that moves and stands.

sanskrit: uccā patantam aruṇaṃ suparṇaṃ madhye divas taraṇiṃ bhrājamāṇam | paśyema tvā savitāraṃ yam āhur ajasraṃ jyotir yad avindad atriḥ ||
english: Flying high, ruddy, beautiful-winged, swift, blazing in the middle of heaven — may we behold you, O Savitar, whom they call the imperishable light which Atri found.

sanskrit: divas pṛṣṭhe dhāvamānaṃ suparṇam adityāḥ putraṃ nāthakāma upa yāmi bhītaḥ | sa naḥ sūrya pra tira dīrgham āyur mā riṣāma sumatau te syāma ||
english: Running on the back of heaven, the beautiful-winged son of Aditi — longing for a protector, I approach you in fear. O Sun, grant us long life; let us not be harmed; may we be in your good grace.

sanskrit: ahorātrāṇi vidadhat kṛṇvāṇaḥ pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | navaṃnavaṃ sakhībhavaṃ kṛṇuṣe deva sūrya ||
english: Apportioning days and nights, creating the earthly realm, you make yourself ever-new, ever a companion, O divine Sun.

sanskrit: sahasrāhṇyaṃ viyatāv asya pakṣau harer haṃsasya pacataḥ svargam | sa viśvān devān urasy upadadya saṃpaśyan yāti bhuvanāni viśvā ||
english: A thousand days long are the two wings of this tawny swan as they cook the heaven. Holding all gods to his breast, beholding all, he travels through all the worlds.

sanskrit: rohito loko abhavad rohito 'gre prajāpatiḥ | rohito yajñānāṃ mukhaṃ rohito jyotir ucyate ||
english: Rohita became the world; Rohita was Prajāpati in the beginning. Rohita is the face of sacrifices; Rohita is called the light.

sanskrit: rohito bhūto abhavad rohito bhavyam ābharat | rohito yajñānāṃ mukhaṃ rohitaḥ svar ā bharat ||
english: Rohita became what has come to be; Rohita brought forth what is yet to be. Rohita is the face of sacrifices; Rohita brought the sun-world.

sanskrit: rohitaḥ kālo abhavad rohito 'ty atapad divam | rohito raśmibhir bhūmiṃ samudram anu saṃ carāt ||
english: Rohita became time; Rohita blazed forth beyond heaven. Rohita with his rays has traveled along the earth and the ocean.

sanskrit: sarvā diśaḥ saṃ carati rohito adhipatir divaḥ | divaṃ samudram ād bhūmiṃ sarvān lokān vi rakṣatu ||
english: Rohita travels through all the quarters; Rohita is the lord of heaven. May he protect heaven, the ocean, and the earth — all the worlds.
